story.body: You got Brooke down and the commonplace open, saw the gap, and left it. You did not write a word into the dash. The cat stayed on the Golding.

story.body: You wrote the first boast and stopped the frame there. You did not fill the old gap. You did not move the cat.

participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: no help and no hindrance from the cat

story.body: You wrote the bite and the cry, and you did not pause the frame to explain where the feud began. The sheet is still clean of blots. The cat stayed where he was.

title: Wrote the bitten thumb and the citizens' cry

relations.note: a cat who slept the brawl out

story.body: You ran the sheet to the Prince and did not start another. You marked the count and the cleanness, and you did not write out his sentence. You left the old gap alone.

title: Wrote ninety lines of the brawl

participation.context: Said the order, and stayed with the decision not to go.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: a sleeper who had the right idea

story.body: You put the jest before the death, and you called the heat by its month. You refused the old blank a second time. You decided against the two o'clock play without calling it a principle.

title: Said they jest first, then somebody is out
